stemMd: Although the director was usually guarded about finances, her account of the failed project was unusually ______: she listed every overrun and acknowledged her own mistakes.
explanationMd: Although signals a contrast with guarded behaviour. Listing costs and admitting mistakes indicates frankness, so candid supplies the needed contrast. The clue concerns openness rather than length or style.

distractorRationale.d: Brevity is not established by the detailed account.
distractorRationale.c: This conflicts with listing overruns and acknowledging mistakes.
distractorRationale.a: The account concerns past failure, not prediction.
distractorRationale.e: Decorative language does not express openness.
